categories.main_business_segments: Qingdao Greensum Ecology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in ecological environment construction, covering natural environment ecological restoration such as vegetation restoration, soil and water conservation, desertification control, soil remediation, land consolidation, and water environment governance, as well as artificial environment ecological construction including landscape gardening, municipal engineering, and sanitation services. The company also engages in soil environment monitoring, seedling sales, ecological restoration engineering design, and other related businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary technologies including granular soil preparation and granular spraying vegetation restoration technology, enabling rapid and large-scale vegetation restoration even in harsh environments. It designs and manufactures key equipment such as spraying machines and soil granule generators in-house. The company integrates technology consulting, R&D, raw material production, equipment manufacturing, project design, construction, and operation management into a full-industry chain. It also pursues innovations in zero-carbon building technology, organic static fermentation, and carbon sink estimation methodologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company’s primary customers are government departments and state-owned entities, including municipal governments and public infrastructure projects. It also serves construction enterprises and real estate developers. Its projects span ecological restoration of mining areas, urban green spaces, land consolidation, and water environment projects. The company actively pursues large-scale government-backed projects and participates in the Belt and Road Initiative for overseas markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations cover all 31 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions in China, with a focus on Qingdao and Shandong Province. It also has significant projects in Southwest, Northwest, Northeast, and other regions of China. The company is expanding overseas, particularly in Central Asian countries such as Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, and Kazakhstan, through ecological restoration and seedling export projects.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the ecological restoration supply chain, providing integrated services from technical consulting, raw material production, equipment manufacturing, project design, construction, to operation and maintenance. It uniquely controls key raw material production and equipment manufacturing, enhancing cost and quality control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include becoming a world-class ecological restoration specialist, expanding the full-industry chain, and integrating ESG principles into management. R&D focuses on granular spraying technology, soil substrate optimization, zero-carbon building systems, organic waste fermentation, carbon sink estimation, and ecological value assessment. The company emphasizes digital transformation with 'data governance' to improve operational efficiency and project management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through project-based contract income from ecological restoration, landscaping, municipal engineering, and sanitation services. The company secures contracts mainly via bidding and negotiation, with long-term contracts spanning 1-5 years. It also earns income from sales of ecological products, seedlings, and technology licensing. Investment income and government subsidies contribute to non-operating income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's ecological restoration industry, recognized as a national high-tech enterprise and a pioneer in vegetation restoration technology. It holds numerous patents and industry standards, and has strong brand recognition. The industry is fragmented with many small players, but Greensum Ecology distinguishes itself through comprehensive technology, full-industry chain integration, and extensive project experience across diverse climatic zones.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 377 million, a 16.84% decrease from 2022, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 34.17 million, down 39.23%. Total assets grew 35.47% to RMB 1.79 billion, with equity of RMB 905 million. The company issued RMB 400 million in convertible bonds in 2023 to optimize capital structure. Despite revenue decline, order backlog reached a record RMB 1.12 billion, supporting sustainable growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Greensum Ecology offers unique ecological restoration solutions based on its proprietary 'Greensum Ecology' theoretical system and granular spraying technology, enabling effective restoration in harsh and complex environments with minimal artificial traces. Its vertically integrated model, including raw material production and equipment manufacturing, provides cost and quality advantages. The company’s comprehensive project management, digitalized operations, and strong R&D capabilities differentiate it as a reliable, innovative ecological restoration partner.
